definitions.explanation: A fence or boundary made of closely planted shrubs or trees. A traditional feature of Japanese residential gardens.

examples.english: I can see a house beyond the hedge.

examples.japanese: ⟦ブロック{塀|べい}→ブロック塀：28373_burokkubei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{生垣|いけがき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{植|う}える→植える：01210_ueru⟧ことで、{街並|まちな}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかく→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: By planting hedges instead of block walls, the streetscape becomes softer.

notes:
USAGE:
Common plants used for {生垣|いけがき} in Japan include ⟦{椿|つばき}→椿：04401_tsubaki⟧ (camellia), ⟦{山茶花|さざんか}→山茶花：21816_sazanka⟧ (sasanqua), and カイヅカイブキ (Chinese juniper). Many Japanese municipalities offer subsidies for planting {生垣|いけがき} instead of concrete walls for earthquake safety and greening.
